content.title: About
content.content: Fat‑free salad dressing NFS (code 4991) is a light vinaigrette made from water, vinegar, aromatic herbs and spices. The product contains no fat, making it suitable for low‑calorie diets and for people monitoring their energy intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fat‑free dressing is frequently used in restaurants for “light” menu items.
The formula includes a vinegar concentrate that helps keep vegetables fresh.
It is very low in calories – about 10 kcal per 100 ml.
Without fat, the dressing does not form a film on the surface of salads.
Natural flavorings such as basil, oregano and garlic are often added.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The absence of fat makes the dressing suitable for reducing overall caloric intake.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Vinegar stimulates gastric juice production, aiding digestion.

items.title: Rich in aromatics
items.content: Herbs and spices provide antioxidant properties and pleasant taste without added sugar.

items.title: Diet‑friendly
items.content: No fat and low carbohydrate content make it compatible with keto and low‑carb diets.

items.title: Enhances vitamin absorption
items.content: Acidity of vinegar helps better absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins from vegetables.

items.title: Herb allergy
items.content: The product may contain herbs that can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some versions may have elevated salt levels; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drizzle over ready salads, use in marinades for fish or chicken, add to vegetable stews, or as a dressing for cold appetizers. Pairs well with leafy greens, tomatoes, cucumbers and carrots.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–8 °C. After opening, consume within 7 days. Do not freeze. Discard if color, odor or taste changes.
